claim: The current hlib_pace_open and hlib_debt_open lose DE (and hlib_debt_open also HL), unlike the first library version; save the game's value around them or take it from its saved copy.

evidence.text: The current hlib_pace_open / hlib_debt_open lose DE (V1 kept it); an engine moving off HLIB_PACE_V1 saves DE around them.
hlib_debt_open loses HL: a hook that needs the game's HL takes it from its saved copy.
